title: Lor San Tekka
description: A legendary explorer and adherent of the once-forbidden Church of the Force, Lor San Tekka was a longtime ally of the forces of good. After the Battle of Endor and before retiring, he helped Luke Skywalker recover secret Jedi lore. After entering into retirement, General Organa  dispatched Poe Dameron to retrieve a map from Lor San Tekka, believing it might help lead them to Luke after his disappearance.
